title: Selling Plans Seller Terms — One Plan per Seller Profile
content:
**Clause.** A seller profile holds at most one **Selling Plans** plan at a time — a maximum of 1 open selling plan per seller. A seller who wants a different plan changes the existing plan rather than opening a second one. A closed plan does not count, so a seller whose plan closed may open a new one.

## The clause, condition by condition

| The seller profile currently shows | A new plan may be opened | What the seller does to hold a different plan |
|---|---|---|
| No selling plan | Yes | Opens the plan |
| One plan that is closed | Yes — a closed plan does not count | Opens the new plan |
| One plan in any state other than closed (pending verification, active, restricted or cancellation scheduled) | No — the profile already holds its 1 plan | Changes the existing plan |

## Basis Q&A

**A seller on the Starter Store wants the Premium Store. Is a second plan opened?** No. The profile already holds one plan, so the seller changes the existing Starter Store plan to the Premium Store.

**A seller's Basic Store plan closed last month. Can the seller open an Individual Seller Plan?** Yes. The closed plan does not count toward the limit of 1, so a new plan may be opened.
